title: Explore your journey
description: The incident map and walking-route comparisons are being developed. This preview does not access your location.
estimateDescription: AI classifications, hotspots, and route indicators will be estimates. No route can be guaranteed safe.
note: Based on community reports. This is not a guarantee of safety.
mapA11y: Map of Sri Lanka showing areas with reported incidents. Use the list view for a text version.
errorTitle: We couldn't load the map data
empty: There are no areas to show yet.

map.title: Reported incident areas
map.areaApproximate: This area is approximate. It never shows the exact place an incident was reported.
map.legendDescription: Each shaded area covers a place where several incidents were reported. Areas are approximate and never show an exact incident location.
map.suppressed_one: {{count}} area is not shown because too few reports were available.
map.suppressed_other: {{count}} areas are not shown because too few reports were available.
map.emptyDescription: This does not mean the area is safe. It means there is not enough reported information to show a pattern.
map.disclaimer: These areas show where incidents were reported, not where harassment actually occurs. Reporting is uneven, so busy areas may show more reports.
map.loadFailed: Reported areas could not be loaded. Please try again.

confidence.high: The AI read these reports clearly
confidence.moderate: The AI was moderately sure of these reports
confidence.low: The AI was unsure of these reports, so this area counts for less

planner.title: Plan a journey
planner.locationDenied: Location permission was declined. You can still set your start point by tapping the map.
planner.locationUnavailable: Your location could not be determined. You can set your start point by tapping the map.
planner.noResults: No matching place found. You can also tap the map.
planner.hint: Tap a marked area on the map to see what was reported there.
planner.subtitle: Where are you going?

evidence.insufficient: Not enough reports to show a pattern
evidence.limited: Based on a small number of reports
evidence.moderate: Based on a moderate number of reports

routes.title: Route options
routes.noReportedIssues: No reported issues along this route
routes.noAlternativeDescription: No alternative avoided enough reported areas to be worth the extra time. The option with the fewest is marked below.
routes.loadFailed: Routes could not be compared. Please try again.
routes.disclaimer: Route comparisons are estimates based on reported incidents. No route is guaranteed to be safe. Use your own judgement.
routes.approximateGeometry: These paths are approximate. The routing service could not be reached, so they do not follow real streets.
routes.roadNetworkWalking: Walking paths follow the road network: the routing service has no separate pedestrian profile. Check crossings and footpaths yourself.
routes.clearRouteNote: This route enters no reported area. It is offered however long it takes, so check the extra time before choosing it.
routes.originInArea: Your starting point is inside a reported area, so no route can avoid it.
routes.destinationInArea: Your destination is inside a reported area, so no route can avoid it.
routes.nothingToAvoidTitle: No reported areas on these routes
routes.nothingToAvoidDescription: None of these routes pass an area with reported incidents, so there is nothing to detour around. This is not a promise that any of them is safe.
routes.noClearRouteTitle: No route avoids every reported area
routes.noClearRouteDescription: Every option here passes at least one. A way around them was looked for and none was found, so the least-exposed option is marked below.

timePeriod.label: Time of day
timePeriod.defaultedToNow: Showing {{period}}, the current time. Choose another period to compare.

journey.title: Walk this route
journey.subtitle: Follow your position as you go, and let someone watch if you want.
journey.inAreaTitle: You are in a reported area
journey.inArea: Incidents have been reported around here. This is not a warning about now, and it does not mean something will happen.
journey.inAreaNamed: Incidents have been reported around {{area}}. This is not a warning about now, and it does not mean something will happen.
journey.shareExpiry: The link stops working when you end the journey, arrive, or after two hours.
journey.shareFailed: The journey could not be shared. You can still walk it; nothing was sent.
journey.privacyNote: Your location stays on this device unless you share it, and sharing stops the moment the journey ends.
journey.locationDenied: Location permission was declined, so the journey cannot follow you.
journey.locationUnavailable: Your location could not be determined, so the journey cannot follow you.
journey.sharedUnavailable: This journey is not available. It may have ended, the traveller may have arrived, or the link may have expired.
journey.sharedCaveat: You are seeing where someone chose to share their walk. It is not a safety guarantee, and it stops when they end the journey.
